# DataLakehouse.help

DataLakehouse.help is an open technical reference for data engineers and architects building modern data infrastructure on open-source lakehouse stacks. It is maintained by Alex Merced, Head of Developer Relations at Dremio and author of multiple books on data lakehouse architecture and Apache Iceberg.

## Summary

This site provides authoritative documentation, guides, and hands-on tutorials covering:

- Data lakehouse architecture concepts, history, and design patterns
- Apache Iceberg table format (the leading open standard for data lakehouses)
- Migration guides: Hive → Iceberg, Delta Lake → Iceberg, Apache Hudi → Iceberg
- Comparison of table formats: Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake
- Data catalogs: Nessie, Hive Metastore, AWS Glue, Apache Polaris
- Query engines: Dremio, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Trino
- Agentic AI patterns for querying data lakehouses (MCP, REST catalog APIs, semantic layers)
- Data modeling: star schema, normalization, slowly changing dimensions
- Optimization: clustering, partitioning, compaction, compression
- Security: RBAC, ABAC, encryption, hard deletes in Apache Iceberg
- Ingestion tools and patterns: Fivetran, Airbyte, Apache Flink, Apache Spark
- Python and Java SDKs for Apache Iceberg
- Big data glossary: 100+ definitions of key data engineering terms

## About the Author

Alex Merced is Head of Developer Relations at Dremio, a leading open lakehouse platform company. He is the author of books on Apache Iceberg, data lakehouses, and agentic analytics. His work focuses on making open-source data lakehouse technology accessible to data engineers and architects worldwide.
